proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 1 article gives Malayalam a, ā that, yonder; avan, avaḷ, avar, atu, ava that man, that woman, those persons, that thing, those things; atatu each, several; aṅṅu, aṅṅunnu there, thither; aṅṅane, aṅṅine that way, thus; aṅṅiṭam, aṅṅōṭu there; aṅṅiṭ-iṅṅiṭam here and there; atā…. The Byari survey form attare “that much” is proposed within this article family.
